decisions: Minutes of the August 6, 2025 board meeting approved as amended.
Approved reallocation of $180,000 from the discretionary marketing budget to the professional services delivery fund; Pierre Dubois to present revised full-year forecast at the October board meeting.

Authorized Margaret Holvan and Aiyana Park to negotiate Acme Corp contract renewal at current pricing with expanded service deliverables; maximum 5% fee concession pre-approved only to secure a minimum two-year term; Pierre Dubois to prepare revised pricing model by September 12, 2025.
Approved engagement of Vendor A (NexaFlow) for infrastructure upgrade at a cost not to exceed $320,000; Aiyana Park designated project lead with contract finalization deadline of September 19, 2025.

Approved formation of a Talent Retention Task Force led by Aiyana Park; conditionally approved budget of up to $150,000 per annum for career pathway framework and retention bonus program targeting a January 1, 2026 launch.
Authorized a go/no-go feasibility assessment for a government-sector consulting proposal opportunity, to be completed and circulated by September 17, 2025.
